author: Toshikatsu Oga (The HORIZONs Co., Ltd.), authored independently; no shared checker with other adapters

declarations.consumes: an MCP endpoint URL, the origin's /.well-known/mcp-conduct.json (owner consent), and the gate-derived coordinate (day and tool, derived from sources the target does not control)

establishes.claim_type: conformance verdict over the gate's conditions (verified / pending / held), with reachable true, false or null
establishes.scope: one endpoint, one checked_at, one vantage (probed_via); the judge is not the endpoint's operator

declarations.issued_at: checked_at (the record's own field). The record's scope_note says in prose what the disclaimers say here: the gate verifies conformance and disclosure only, and does NOT verify that any price or figure returned by the server is correct.

declarations.endpoint: gate.horizonshield.dev /check on the operator's own endpoints (NENRIN Layer 4, self-application)
declarations.consumes: the same inputs as above, for an endpoint operated by the gate's operator

establishes.claim_type: conformance verdict over the gate's conditions (verified / pending / held), with reachable true, false or null
establishes.scope: one endpoint, one checked_at, one vantage; the judge and the target share an operator

declarations.issued_at: checked_at. Self-measurement is the operator's statement about its own endpoint, measured with the same instrument under the same rules. It is exactly why the witness path exists: only a second party's walk can establish INDEPENDENT_JUDGMENT about these rows.

establishes.claim_type: the record's bytes, with record_sha256 and recompute_note removed and serialised in the record's key order, hash to its record_sha256, so it was not altered after issue

declarations.verification_time: when this recompute ran, distinct from the verdict's checked_at. The tool's own text: verified true means the verdict hashes to its own record_sha256; this is a finding about the record, not about whether the verdict was right.

declarations.endpoint: ledger.horizonshield.dev POST /witness (NENRIN Layer 1, a2a-conduct-walk-v1 / jidec-path-v1 with a witness field)
declarations.consumes: an endpoint, walked by a second party from that party's own vantage, with per-node response body hashes

establishes.claim_type: walk verdict (ok / not ok) over the walk's assertions, with per-node body sha256
establishes.scope: one endpoint, one walked_at, one witness name and vantage

declarations.issued_at: walked_at. The ledger accepts a schema-valid record with no editorial step; a walk becomes NOT_BACKDATED only once its daily batch is stamped (see the ledger declaration).

declarations.endpoint: NENRIN ring verify mode (make_ring.py --verify; make_ring.js, the independent Node.js reimplementation)
declarations.consumes: a ring file, the endpoint's committed /history export for the month, and the previous ring

establishes.claim_type: the ring file is byte for byte the deterministic function of this history export and the previous ring (sha256 of file bytes equal)
establishes.scope: one endpoint, one calendar month, one ring file

declarations.verification_time: when the verify ran. The ring's own limits sentence is the disclaimer in prose: one witness only, so no discrepancy could have been recorded; a single witness can be wrong and nobody was positioned to say so; unmeasured is not failed; counts only, never a rate, a score or a rank. Byte reproducibility proves the ring layer is deterministic, not that the measurements inside it are true.

declarations.endpoint: ledger.horizonshield.dev JIDEC entry with OpenTimestamps proof
declarations.consumes: claim bytes: the sha256 of a verdict record, a monthly ring list, a specification, or a witness batch

establishes.claim_type: these exact bytes existed no later than the Bitcoin block that attests the entry

declarations.issued_at: the anchor block time (pending calendar attestations until the block lands). The ledger's own sentence: it proves the claim and its date, not its truth. Same class and same field as invinoveritas's freshness_beacon; the vocabulary was already aligned before either manifest was written.
